name: Fedor
text: Fedor the canteen till is short again n the float box is locked in the office, can u bring the spare key b4 the lunch lot come down

name: Jezdimirovic
text: Jezdimirovic the racking in aisle 4 got hit by the forklift yday, two uprights are bent n the pallets r leaning. can u cone it off n book the repair b4 someone drops a load

name: Dhananjay Isiah
text: Dhananjay Isiah the baler keeps tripping the breaker in the yard, weve reset it three times since lunch n its red hot every time. can u get the sparky out tomorow plz, the cardboard is stacking up n the fire warden is doing his rounds friday so it needs sorting

name: Marielou Salvini
text: Marielou Salvini the van keys arent in the usual drawer n the spare fob is missing too, any idea who had them last

name: Tanguy
text: Tanguy the mixer in the wet room is making a grinding noise again n the paddle wobbles, i dont wanna run it till someone looks. the batch for the east pour is on hold till then

name: Maratsee
text: Maratsee the shutter on bay 2 is stuck half way n the opener just clicks, weve tried the manual chain n it wont budge either. two lorries are due at 2 so can u ring the door firm n see if they can come today, otherwise well have to turn the loads away

name: De Fanti
text: De Fanti the roomba under the desks got stuck on a cable n died mid clean, can u fish it out b4 the visitors come

name: Arnisi Köle Campell
text: Arnisi Köle Campell the badge printer is printing blank cards again, ive swapped the ribbon n cleaned the head but no joy. three new starters need passes by monday so we need a fix or a loaner

name: Mayza
text: Mayza the freezer alarm went off at 3am n nobody knew the code, we moved what we could to the chiller n taped the door shut. the duty phone list on the wall is out of date, half those numbers are dead. can u update it n book an engineer to look at the seal

name: Altevogt
text: Altevogt the lift is stuck on floor 3 with the doors open n the alarm bell is going, can u ring the service line

name: Chuan Jesar
text: Chuan Jesar the goods lift is out again, been waiting on the part for weeks n the fitter keeps pushing the date. can u chase the supplier n get a written eta, the crews r carrying everything up the stairs meanwhile

name: Giamila Merly
text: Giamila Merly the kiln room extraction isnt pulling, you can smell the fumes halfway down the corridor. weve shut it down n put the sign up but the next firing is booked for tuesday n the customer is already chasing. can maintenance look at the fan or do we need the specialist firm

name: Yiwei
text: Yiwei covered the early desk and signed for the courier bags. Two parcels were scanned twice and corrected before the van left.

name: Elalouf
text: Elalouf chaired the welfare meeting and took the notes for the staff council. The canteen survey results were summarized for the board and the new break rota was agreed. The minutes go up on the noticeboard by Friday.

name: Lammade Lunter
text: Lammade Lunter ran the stock check on the bonded warehouse and reconciled the discrepancies from last quarter. Nine lines were adjusted after the photographs came back and the serials were matched to the intake sheets. The insurers asked for a summary, which was drafted the same afternoon for the manager to sign.

name: Evica Lisann
text: Evica Lisann walked the new starters through the fire plan and showed them the muster point by the south gate. Both signed the induction sheet.

name: Mejda
text: Mejda noticed the chiller alarm on the night round and moved the dairy to the backup unit before it warmed through. The engineer was called at six and the stock was saved. The log entry notes the door seal needs replacing.

name: Spiekerman
text: Spiekerman took the complaint about the delivery noise and measured the levels from the boundary over two evenings. The readings were under the limit at the boundary but above it close to the loading dock. A barrier was quoted, and the depot manager asked for the results to go to the planning office as well.

name: Seif Bejedi
text: Seif Bejedi sorted the returns bay and reboxed the damaged items for the auction. The courier took the refund parcels at four.

name: Di Nucci
text: Di Nucci restocked the first aid points across the site and replaced the out of date dressings. The defibrillator pads were checked and the battery indicator read green. A note went to the safety officer about the missing eye wash bottles.

name: Kamolchanok
text: Kamolchanok took over the training records after the audit and rebuilt the expiry tracker from scratch. All the lapsed certificates were chased in one week and the remaining gaps were booked. The new system flags renewals a month ahead, and the folder is backed up nightly to the shared drive.

name: Ragnoli
text: Ragnoli repaired the bench vice and returned the borrowed tools to the crib. The damaged chisels were sent for regrinding.

name: Fiorina Beija
text: Fiorina Beija reorganized the sample library and labelled every drawer with the shelf life dates. Expired batches were pulled for disposal and logged. The courier collected the archive boxes for the off site store on Thursday.

name: Belem Tagliati
text: Belem Tagliati handled the insurance claim for the flooded storeroom and itemized every lost carton from the inventory. The assessor visited on Tuesday and was walked through the water marks on the wall. A replacement order for the shelving went in the same week, and the paper files were moved to the mezzanine while the floor dries.

name: Kamar
text: can someone look at the fire panel in the east block, Kamar says its showing a fault on zone 5. the log book is on top of it

name: Niethammer
text: the induction for the new guy stalled yday becos the video player in room 2 is broke, Niethammer reckons the disc is scratched n weve got no spare. can we use the small room instead, the slides work fine on the laptop there

name: Staheyeff Bamal
text: the compost delivery got left on the road cos the driver couldnt get the pallet truck up the kerb, Staheyeff Bamal moved what they could by hand n covered the rest with a tarp. can someone bring the sack barrow from the shed n help shift the last of it b4 it rains, the forecast is grim for later

name: Magy Venkata
text: the staff fridge is frosting up again, Magy Venkata thinks the seal is going. can we get it looked at b4 it dies completely

name: Georgian
text: the hand dryer in the gents is sparking when u press it, Georgian saw it n put a bag over it. can maintenance come today, weve unplugged it at the spur but ppl keep trying to use it anyway

name: Kafa
text: the roller door on the wash bay has been grinding for weeks n now it stops half way, Kafa had a look n says the chain has stretched. weve lubed it but that only helps for a day. can we get a proper quote for a new motor b4 the winter, if it fails when its freezing were stuck

name: Amantia Nemiah
text: the shredder by the safe has jammed again, Amantia Nemiah cleared it once but it keeps eating the credit slips. any chance of a new one

name: van Rooij
text: the labels for the apothecary jars came in the wrong font n half the batch is smudged, van Rooij is sending them back but the reprint wont land till next week. we can still fill the orders with the plain ones if the client agrees

name: Adelina
text: the kiln shelves are warping after the last two firings and the middle one has a crack along the edge, Adelina caught it while she was loading the glaze batch. weve pulled that shelf for now n moved the orders to the small kiln, but it pushes everything back a day. can we order two sets n a spare

name: Leko
text: the gate on the west side is catching on the post again, Leko filed it down last month but the wood swelled up. can u bring the plane in

name: Detar Sevin
text: the visitor badges keep going missing from the drawer, Detar Sevin counted eleven left when the order says twenty. people are handing them back to the wrong desk. can we get a sign on the tray

name: Albino Tya
text: the manhole outside the kitchen door is loose n clanks every time a van goes over, Albino Tya marked it with a cone but the tape blew off in the night. the depot says its not their cover so its been bouncing between teams for a week. can u pin down whose it is

name: Blloku
text: the stair light on the north wing hasnt worked since monday, Blloku reported it twice. can u check the job sheet

name: Volkan
text: The morning batch failed the viscosity check twice before the break, so Volkan recalibrated the mixer and ran a fresh sample. The results came back within spec and the line restarted before lunch. The batch records were updated with the readings.

name: Miller
text: The courier left the pallets on the kerb outside the yard gate instead of the yard, and Miller had them moved before the rain started. Two cartons were crushed at the corner and were photographed for the claim. The rest of the load checked out against the manifest, so the delivery was signed with a note. The depot was emailed.

name: Gilad Smith
text: The front desk printer jammed during the ticket rush, and Gilad Smith cleared it and swapped the toner. The queue was moving again within minutes.

name: Batul Parameswary
text: The safety inspection flagged two missing guards on the sanding bays, and Batul Parameswary ordered replacements the same afternoon. Until they arrive the bays run with a written clearance from the supervisor. The fix is booked for Thursday.

name: Marlei
text: The fundraiser takings were short of the target by lunchtime on Friday, so Marlei put a note in the newsletter and posted the total on the board. Two local firms matched the gap by the end of the day and the roof repair is now fully funded. Thank you notes go out on Monday.

name: Prastaj
text: The window cleaner broke a pane on the upper floor, and Prastaj taped it and called the glazier. A temporary board went up the same day.

name: De Friend
text: The racking audit ran long because the scanner kept dropping the network, and De Friend finished the last aisles by hand. The counts were typed up on Saturday morning and matched the system. The scanner goes back to the supplier.

name: Gaya Bidiville
text: The inventory count dragged into the second day after the handhelds all lost sync at once, and Gaya Bidiville rebuilt the count from the paper sheets. Every discrepancy was traced to the two hours the system was down, so no stock is actually missing. The file was re uploaded and signed off by the auditor.

name: Isolina
text: The deep clean in the east kitchen overran, so Isolina moved the night crew to the canteen first. Both rooms passed the morning check.

name: Acero
text: The trolley washer broke down mid shift and the trays were stacking up fast, so Acero ran them through the old machine in the back. It held up until the new part arrived on Wednesday. The repair note is in the maintenance folder.

name: Alice Johnson
text: The tenant meeting ran late over the parking charges and the bike store plan, and Alice Johnson took the vote and wrote up the agreed points. The new permits will be issued from the office on weekdays, no charge for the first one per flat. The minutes were emailed to everyone on the list by Saturday.

name: Niveetha Sloane
text: The photocopier lease came up for renewal, and Niveetha Sloane compared the two quotes and picked the cheaper one. The new terms start in April.

name: Jungmichel
text: The pallet truck was booked for the morning run but the battery died on the ramp, and Jungmichel pushed the last two loads by hand. The charger was swapped out the same day and the truck passed its check.
